html:
The most common problems, and how to fix them. The checker on dehub.io/apps/dev tells you which field is wrong in plain words, so start there.

Manifest problems

MessageFix
Not found at /.well-known/dehub.jsonServe the file at exactly that path over https. Many hosts hide folders that start with a dot; allow .well-known.
Found, but it is not valid JSONPaste the file into a JSON checker. Trailing commas are the usual cause.
homeUrl must be on your domainhomeUrl has to be on the same domain that serves the manifest.
ownership.signature: Signed by 0x…, not 0x…Sign with the same wallet you put in ownership.address, or use the Sign button on /apps/dev.
The app must be served over httpsLocalhost and http work only in developer preview (Launch on /apps/dev), not for submitting.

When the app runs

ProblemFix
The splash screen stays for 8 secondsCall dehub.ready() once your first screen is on.
Not running inside dehubThe page was opened on its own. Check dehub.isInDehub() and show a normal web version.
signin errorThe person is signed out of DeHub. Ask them to sign in, or let them use your app as a guest.
unsupported on pay or addAppDeveloper previews cannot take payments or be added. Submit the app first.
The app looks stretched on desktopIt should not: DeHub runs mini apps in a phone-width column. Design for 375–430px wide.
Links do nothingUse dehub.actions.openUrl(url) for external links; mini apps cannot navigate the DeHub tab.

On your server

ProblemFix
Token fails with an audience errorSet audience to your app's domain exactly, with no https:// and no path.
Token fails with an expiry errorTokens last one hour. Call dehub.auth.getToken() again; the SDK refreshes it.
Notifications are skipped as notAddedOnly people who added your app get notifications. Ask with dehub.actions.addApp().
Notifications are skipped as rateLimitedOne every 30 seconds and ten a day per person. Combine updates into one notification.
429 from the REST APIWait for the x-ratelimit-reset-* seconds before retrying.
